Frontend verification confirmed all features working: Profile update with LinkedIn URL, Study group delete/leave, Org admin staff/participants display, Staff invitation, Content upload visibility.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All Phase 4 fixes verified working: (1) Profile update saves LinkedIn URL via PUT /api/auth/profile with JSON body, (2) GET /api/auth/me returns saved LinkedIn URL, (3) Study group delete/leave endpoints working - creator can delete, non-creator can leave, (4) Org admin can view staff via GET /api/org/staff and participants via GET /api/org/participants, (5) Staff invitation via POST /api/org/invite-staff, (6) Content upload via POST /api/content/course/{id}/content with JSON body, (7) Frontend Settings page has LinkedIn Profile URL field, (8) Frontend Study Groups page has delete buttons for creator's groups.
